name: oops-i-did-it-again
title_zh: 错误当场变机制，不许只道歉
tagline_zh: 每次说错、判错、被纠正，立刻把错误归类成已知失效模式，再变成一条守卫规则或钩子。下次同样坑自动绕开。
tagline_en: Every wrong claim or false pass becomes a classified failure mode, then a guard rule or hook. Next time the same.
desc_en: Run IMMEDIATELY after any mistake, wrong claim, false pass, or correction. Classifies the error against the known failure modes, then converts it into a MECHANISM (a guard rule, a hook, a gate) instead of a promise to do better. Use when the agent catches its own error, when the user catches one, or when a result turns out to be wrong. Also use when a "green" result looks too good.
why_zh: 它不让你写「下次注意」，而是逼你产出可执行的机制。错误被当成数据，不是羞耻。绿色结果太漂亮也会触发它。
why_en: It refuses 'I'll do better' and forces an executable mechanism. Errors are data, not shame. A too-green result triggers it.
limit_zh: 只处理已发生的错误或可疑的绿色结果，不预测未来风险。需要你或用户先指出错误，它不会主动巡逻。产物是规则文本。
limit_en: Only handles past errors or suspicious green results, not future risks. Needs an error to be pointed out first—no active patrol. Output is rule.
title_en: Turn every mistake into a mechanism, not an apology
